content:
# What changed

Glass sits **above** content, never inside it. Bars, sheets and floating buttons get it. Cards do not.

## To show in the video

- Tab bar shrinking on scroll
- The mini player above the tab bar
- Menus growing out of their button

## Checklist

- [x] Record the scroll demo
- [ ] Record the sheet demo
- [ ] Voiceover

> The interface gets out of the way of the content.

More at [Apple's design page](https://developer.apple.com/design/).
